ingredients.note: Whole Dried Basil, Sage, Oregano, Savory, Rosemary, Thyme & Marjoram

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients & make the Italian dressing
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut off and discard the root end of the lettuce; roughly chop the leaves. Halve the cucumber lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Combine in a large bowl.
In a bowl, combine the ricotta, a drizzle of olive oil, and as much of the chile paste as you'd like, depending on how spicy you'd like the dish to be; season with salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vinegar, half the Italian seasoning (you will have extra), half the parmesan, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil.

steps.title: Brown the zucchini
instructions: In a large pan (nonstick, if you have one), heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil on medium-high until hot.
Add the zucchini rounds in an even layer; season with salt and pepper. Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer to a plate. Wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Toast the baguettes
instructions: In the same pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil on medium until hot.

Add the halved baguettes, cut side down. Cook 4 to 6 minutes, or until browned. Flip and cook 2 to 3 minutes, or until lightly browned (if the pan seems dry, add a drizzle of olive oil before flipping).
Transfer to a work surface. Carefully rub the cut sides with the peeled garlic clove, then discard the clove. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Assemble the sandwiches
instructions: Assemble the sandwiches using the toasted baguettes, spicy ricotta, browned zucchini, chopped peppers, and chopped olives.

steps.title: Make the salad & serve your dish
instructions: To the bowl of prepared lettuce and cucumber, add enough of the Italian dressing to coat (you may have extra); season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Serve the sandwiches with the salad on the side. Garnish the salad with the remaining parmesan.
